请在时间线选中一条字幕，查看和调整它的设置。: Select a caption in the timeline to view and edit its settings.
仅应用到当前选中的字幕。: Applies only to the selected caption.
拖动字幕位置，方向键微调: Drag to position captions; use arrow keys to fine-tune
拖动文字调整画面位置，也可用方向键微调。: Drag text to position it, or fine-tune with arrow keys.
每次最多 50 段、8000 字: Up to 50 segments and 8,000 characters at a time
已加入时间线；字幕按每段实际配音时长对齐，可继续调整。: Added to the timeline. Captions match each voiceover segment’s actual duration and can be adjusted further.
已完成的配音片段保留在时间线。: Completed voiceover segments remain on the timeline.
输入台词，每行对应一段配音: Enter dialogue, one voiceover segment per line
请填写文字，结束时间须大于开始时间。: Enter text and an end time later than the start time.
填写配音稿后即可生成: Enter your script to generate voiceover
点击模板应用到全部字幕，单条样式可在下方调整。: Click a preset to apply to all captions. Adjust individual styles below.
使用词级时间；时间相对于本句开始。: Using word timestamps relative to the caption start.
当前按文字均分时长，不代表语音对齐。: Timing is evenly distributed across text, not aligned to speech.
